expectations.text: Depth is allocated to Microsoft Ads while Google coverage stays at maintenance weight (release-note and roundup skims)
expectations.evidence: The plan is explicitly and structurally front-loaded on Microsoft: the assumption block states "Microsoft gets depth (you have zero mental model there and headlines can't build one); Google gets a breadth refresh only (you already have years of context)", and the header says it is "front-loaded on Microsoft since that's the actual gap." Week 1 (~115 min) is entirely Microsoft — official blog (15), two Paid Media Pros tutorials (50), the platform's own certification/help modules (40) — plus a cheap PPC Land roundup. Week 2 adds 50 more minutes of Microsoft video on import tool / UET conversion

expectations.text: Depth is allocated to Microsoft Ads while Google coverage stays at maintenance weight (release-note and roundup skims)
expectations.evidence: The plan puts essentially all depth into Microsoft-specific divergences: the 'Skip entirely (you already know this)' section explicitly excludes match types, negatives, ad rank/auction, Quality Score, structure, RSAs, conversion-tracking philosophy and 'PPC 101' as already-known Google material, and every substantive block is Microsoft-only (Learning Lab, Google Ads import quirks, UET tag, Microsoft Advertising Editor, editorial policy for freight, LinkedIn Profile targeting, call tracking deltas). 'What not to bother with' further trims Shopping/Merchant Center, deep bidding-algorithm reading
